notes.title: Patch Update - 0.1.38.8b
notes.content:
Cosmic Patch: The MIX Fall Game Showcase Edition!
This update brings the Online multiplayer lobbies and now it's time to race with your friends. 

We've also been hard at work to bring you this update filled with improvements and fixes. Here’s a summary of what's new in the latest Cosmic Patch! 🚀
Driving and Gameplay 🏎️
Improved Car Handling: We've refined the car mechanics for better handling and collision response. This means your car will feel more predictable and stable, especially after hitting a wall or hitting a ramp and landing on its nose.

Enhanced Car Effects: When your wheels hit the ground, you'll now see corresponding dust effects. We also improved the visual feedback of car collisions by increasing the number of collision points for sparks. ✨

Car Flipping Feedback: An upside-down detection system has been added to the car controller. If your car flips, a new UI panel will appear to provide feedback, including how to reset the car.

Better AI Behavior: AI opponents are now more dynamic. Their risk-taking and attack focus will change based on their position in the race. For example, AIs that are behind will take more risks, while those in the lead will be more cautious. We also fixed a bug that could cause the AI to target itself.
Performance and Stability ⚙️
Smoother Performance: We've made significant optimizations to reduce stutters and improve overall performance. This includes:

Implementing a new object pooling system for things like runtime streaming and particle effects, which helps make the game run smoother and use less memory.

Tweaks to the AI and dynamic leaderboard tracking to give you better framerates and a more stable game.

Faster Loading: We've enabled background loading for audio to improve game performance when loading into a scene. 🎧
UI and Visuals 🎨
Interface and Readability: The in-game information panel now scales better on different screens. We also fixed anchor positions for UI elements to improve visibility.

Camera Adjustments: We've increased the camera's far clip plane to help you see distant objects more clearly. The field of view has also been adjusted for a better perspective. Additionally, camera shake values have been improved for interactions with walls and other obstacles.

Updated Car Selection: The car selection in garage now displays the car's name and has better visual feedback.

Smoother Multiplayer Experience: We've ironed out a bug that made other players' cars look a bit wonky. Now, their wheels will always be in the right place, not floating or stuck in the ground, for a much cleaner visual experience.

Bug Fixes: We've fixed a number of UI navigation issues, particularly for controller support. We also addressed layout inconsistencies in the FTUE (First-Time User Experience) scene. 👾
Thank You ❤️
We want to give a massive thank you to everyone who played the demo during the Steam Racing Fest! Your feedback and suggestions were incredibly valuable. This patch is a direct result of your input, and we've worked hard to address the most important points you raised.

We hope you enjoy this update. Please continue to share your thoughts and talk with the developers directly on our Discord server. See you on the track! 👋

— Cosmic Race Team (Psypher Interactive)

notes.title: Patch Update - 0.1.38.7e
notes.content:
What’s new
Quick Race (Single Player)
You can now dive into a local multiplayer session with a single click bots included, no setup required. Speed over ceremony.

Better Bot Awareness
The result screen now ignores AI when counting players. Because bots don’t wait politely—why should you?

Car Respawn Rework
We’ve completely overhauled the car respawn system with a new system. It’s smarter, faster, and more respectful of personal space (i.e., no more spawning on top of each other).

Button Smash Fix
Menu buttons now chill out after you press them—cooldowns have been added to prevent accidental double-pressing in the heat of a race.
[hr][/hr]Improvements
Camera & UI

Fixed camera FOV for 4:3 aspect ratio.

Adjusted intro cam angles.

UI layout fixes for widescreens.

Settings & Performance

UI now only shows width x height (bye refresh rates).

SSAO toggle actually does something now.

Anti-aliasing properly applies 8x MSAA.

Shadow settings revamped to use URP’s realtime properties.

Audio

Bounce sounds no longer ignore master volume.

Button sounds moved to the proper SFX group.

Crowd noise fixed on Sedna track.

Scene Transitions

Client readiness tracking during scene load—less waiting, fewer bugs.

The game no longer stalls if the host disappears during car selection.
Fixes
🐞 Fixed car explosion on launchpad.

🐞 Fixed rematch buttons not enabling when bots are still racing.

🐞 Fixed chat messages duplicating across server/clients.

🐞 Fixed “waiting for players” logic to count only real humans.
[hr][/hr]


This update is part of our Steam Racing Fest release, and it’s been a wild ride!

Thank you for playing, racing, and occasionally exploding with us.

As always, send feedback our way—especially if something feels off (or too on).

🏁 See you at the starting line.

— Cosmic Race Team (Psypher Interactive)

notes.title: Blast Off! New Cosmic Race Demo Drops for Steam Racing Fest
notes.content:
🚀 Cosmic Race: Galactic Showdown Demo Update is LIVE for Steam Racing Fest!


Strap in, racers! Cosmic Race: Galactic Showdown is back—more chaotic, strategic, and action-packed than ever!

This updated demo launches with Steam Racing Fest, delivering a turbo-charged blend of arcade-speed racing and cosmic vehicular combat, now enhanced with stunning visuals, smoother gameplay, and a refined player experience.


⚡ What’s New in This Demo Build?
🔧 Revamped Power System — Randomized power-ups now split into Utility and Weapon abilities, making every race unpredictable.

💥 6 All-New Abilities — 3 Utility + 3 Weapon-based powers to dominate the track.

🛣 New Track — Military Base: SEDNA, full of high-speed corners and chaos.

🚗 3 Playable Cars — Choose your fighter, each with unique design and handling.

🖥 Drastic Graphical Improvements — Sharper visuals, improved lighting, and better effects across the board.

🧭 Improved Tutorial UX — Smoother onboarding and clearer guidance for new players.

🛠 Revamped Main Menu UI — Cleaner layout, faster navigation.

🔄 Improved Custom Lobby System — Join and manage sessions more easily than ever.

🕹 LAN & Online Multiplayer — Race your friends in custom lobbies, locally or online.



Whether you fly, smash, or swap your way to the finish—this is racing, redefined.

🎮 Download the demo now and take your shot at becoming the next Galactic Champion!


🙏 A Huge Thank You to Our Testers!
We want to extend our deepest gratitude to all the incredible testers who helped us refine and improve Cosmic Race: Galactic Showdown. Your dedication, feedback, and passion were invaluable in shaping this updated demo. Thank you for helping us make the chaos even better!

For all the latest news, updates, and behind-the-scenes glimpses, be sure to follow us on our social channels! We're constantly sharing new content and engaging with our community.

notes.title: Demo Available Again (with Fixes)
notes.content:
Hey Racers!

Get ready to blast off again! We're thrilled to announce that the demo for Cosmic Race: Galactic Showdown is once again available to play on Steam as part of the MGN 2025, Indie Game Carnival event!

If you missed it before, or if you played the demo during the recent Indie Games Utsav event, now is a great time to jump back in!

We want to extend a massive THANK YOU to everyone who played our demo during the Indie Games Utsav and took the time to provide us with your valuable feedback and suggestions. We've been hard at work listening and implementing changes based on what you told us!

This updated demo includes several fixes and enhancements:

 UI Input display mismatch fix: Resolved an issue where the on-screen input display didn't match controller/keyboard inputs correctly.
 LAN server discovery system reworked: Improved reliability and ease of finding local multiplayer games.
 UI Flow in Main menu enhanced: Made navigation smoother and more intuitive.

We're constantly working to make Cosmic Race: Galactic Showdown the best it can be, and your feedback is crucial to that process!

If you enjoy the demo, please help us out by wishlisting Cosmic Race: Galactic Showdown on Steam! Wishlisting is one of the best ways to support indie developers like us and helps us get noticed.

Want to get even more involved? Join our Discord community! This is the best place to get the latest development updates, share your thoughts and suggestions directly with the team, report any issues, or just hang out and chat with fellow cosmic racers.

Dive back into the updated demo and experience the improvements! We can't wait for you to play.

See you on the galactic track!

The Cosmic Race Team
Psypher Interactive

Your feedback has been invaluable in shaping the game. We’ve worked hard to:

 Optimize gameplay for smoother performance,

Your insights continue to guide us, and we couldn’t be more grateful!
    
Join the Conversation on Discord

Stay tuned for more updates, and don’t forget to grab the demo or visit us at Comic Con Mumbai 2025. Let’s race through the stars together!
